mapper.select: select b.ContractId,b.RuleSerialNum,b.ContractName,b.ContractNum,a.ContractchangeId,a.CCNo,a.IsSeal,b.MoneyFlow, b.Type1,b.Type2,b.Type3,b.Type4,b.MainOrgUserID,b.PropertyModel,b.Section,b.CreatedDate from cr_contractchange a inner join cr_contractbasic b on a.ContractId=b.ContractId inner join cr_contractinfo c on a.ContractId=c.ContractId ${ew.customSqlSegment}

select a.ContractID, a.ContractChangeID,a.CcNo,a.Proposer,a.ChangeReason, b.changeType,b.ChangeValue1 as changeAmount,b.ChangeValue3 as changeNoTaxAmount,b.ChangeValue2 as changeTaxAmount from cr_contractchange as a, cr_contractchangedetail as b where a.ContractChangeID=b.ContractChangeID and a.ContractID = #{ContractID}
